{{Quote|Hunting has always been a hobby of mine, but age and poor health pretty much ensure that I can't do it any more. So here's the deal, I'll trade my security beacon for some hunting trophies.|Walker Luskeske, to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]]|<ref name="SWG:FaSB" />}}
'''Walker Luskeske''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he served as [[Security officer/Legends|security officer]] at [[Stonewall Labs]], along with [[Kippy Martin]], under the orders of the [[Chief of Security|Security Chief]] [[Vance Groten]]. After he retired, Luskeske resided at [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]]. He was also a [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]].<ref name="SWG:FaSB" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Walker Luskeske asked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to kill [[Capper spineflap|mountain spineflaps]], including [[Sprywing]], and [[Narglatch/Legends|narglatches]] in the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]] and bring him wings, talons and fangs as trophies. In exchange, he gave the spacer a [[security beacon]] from Stonewall Labs.<ref name="SWG:FaSB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Walker Luskeske appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FaSB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Walker Luskeske was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>

"Walker Luskeske" is a clear wordplay of "[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]."
